article_title: From Paris to DC - why offices are being turned into apartments

tasks.prompt: Why are cities converting more office buildings into apartments?
options: Office demand has fallen while cities need housing and livelier mixed-use districts
New apartments no longer require plumbing or windows
Companies have stopped using all high-rise buildings
Residential construction has been banned outside business districts
tasks.correct_answer: Office demand has fallen while cities need housing and livelier mixed-use districts
tasks.explanation_hebrew: עבודה מהבית הפחיתה את הביקוש למשרדים, ובמקביל ערים מבקשות דיור ואזורים שבהם גם חיים ומבלים.

tasks.prompt: What share of La Défense office buildings could be turned into housing under the unveiled plans?
options: About one fiftieth
About one half
Up to one fifth
Every office building
tasks.explanation_hebrew: רשות הפיתוח של לה דפאנס הציגה תוכנית להסבת עד חמישית מבנייני המשרדים למגורים.

tasks.prompt: What is a major design problem inside many office floors?
options: The lifts are too close to the windows
Central areas often receive no natural light
The buildings have too many bathrooms
Every floor is too narrow for apartments
tasks.correct_answer: Central areas often receive no natural light
tasks.explanation_hebrew: קומות משרדים גדולות כוללות שטח פנימי רחב ללא חלונות, ולכן קשה להפוך את המרכז לחדרי מגורים.

tasks.prompt: What does a 14–15% “vacancy rate” in La Défense mean?
options: 14–15% of buildings need demolition
14–15% of residents work from home
Rents have risen by 14–15%
That proportion of office space is unoccupied
tasks.correct_answer: That proportion of office space is unoccupied
tasks.explanation_hebrew: vacancy rate הוא שיעור השטח שאינו מאוכלס או מושכר; כאן מדובר במשרדים ריקים.

tasks.prompt: How have Washington DC projects sometimes brought light into the middle of converted offices?
options: By creating central atriums or light sinks
By removing all fire-safety systems
By lowering every ceiling
By replacing lifts with balconies
tasks.correct_answer: By creating central atriums or light sinks
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בוושינגטון יצרו לעיתים אטריומים במרכז הבניין כדי להכניס אור טבעי לשטחים פנימיים.

tasks.prompt: What does it mean that tax cuts are “fuelling” conversions in US cities?
options: They are making apartments use more energy
They are preventing private investment
They are encouraging and accelerating conversion projects
They are increasing demand for traditional offices
tasks.correct_answer: They are encouraging and accelerating conversion projects
tasks.explanation_hebrew: fuelling משמש כאן במשמעות של עידוד והאצה: הקלות המס מסייעות לפרויקטים לצאת לפועל.

tasks.prompt: Why is an office-to-apartment conversion not simply a matter of adding furniture?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין לפחות שלושה הבדלים מבניים או רגולטוריים שנדונו בכתבה.
expected_points: Deep office floors may lack natural light in the centre
Office ceilings may be too low for residential conversion
Projects must meet rules for parking, wheelchair access and fire safety

tasks.prompt: Compare how Paris, Washington DC, New York and London are encouraging office conversions.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להבחין בין שאיפות פריז לבין תמריצים וכללים שכבר הופעלו בערים האחרות.
expected_points: Paris La Défense plans to convert up to a fifth of office buildings but developers seek lower taxes and fewer rules
Washington DC uses tax cuts and easier planning approval
New York also offers incentives and has thousands of converted flats in the pipeline
The UK has tax cuts and eased planning rules, with London projects 60% above pre-Covid levels

tasks.prompt: Why do officials want La Défense to offer restaurants, bars, cinemas and gyms as well as offices?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר כיצד עירוב שימושים עשוי לשפר את המשיכה לעובדים, תושבים וחברות.
expected_points: A district used only for work becomes empty and unattractive outside office hours
Leisure amenities make the area more appealing after work
A mixed-use environment can help retain companies and attract residents
It supports the goal of making La Défense a place to live, work and play

tasks.prompt: Write an evidence-based paragraph assessing whether converting Le Diamant is a practical response to post-pandemic office demand.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לשלב יתרון המבוסס על ירידת הביקוש עם לפחות שני אתגרים טכניים או רגולטוריים.
expected_points: Paris office demand has fallen by almost a third over five to six years
La Défense has a 14–15% vacancy rate, creating an opportunity for housing
Le Diamant's deep floor plan creates areas without natural light
Plumbing, ceiling height and residential regulations add cost and complexity
